planets.name: TOI-238 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-238 with a 1.27-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-238 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-238. Its orbit and size follow Egger et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
